mappedContracts.statement: Integrate the current edithatogo/repository-standards system and inherit its latest applicable node/software, supply-chain, coverage, release, verification-receipt, and solo-maintainer controls.
acceptanceCriteria: The repository is registered or refreshed in repository-standards with the correct profile and risk posture.
Centrally managed files are not forked silently; repository-owned deviations are explicit exceptions.
The one-command verification receipt conforms to the current repository-standards schema.
The model remains operable by one maintainer with zero mandatory human approvals and strong automated gates.

mappedContracts.statement: Configure Renovate to track the same prerelease channels used by mainline, pin exact versions and action digests, and open normal blocking PRs rather than experimental-lane updates.
acceptanceCriteria: The inherited edithatogo Renovate preset is used where applicable.
Prerelease following is enabled for selected packages.
Automerge is limited to changes that pass the complete required suite and respect risk classification.
Dependabot is removed only after Renovate is verified healthy.
requiredEvidence: Dependency Dashboard or successful Renovate PR

mappedContracts.statement: Protect the default branch with a solo-maintainer-compatible ruleset requiring stable automated checks while blocking deletion and force pushes.
acceptanceCriteria: No mandatory human approval or CODEOWNERS dependency is introduced.
Required checks are inventoried and stable before activation.
Issue #162 and parent #163 are reused and completed.
